messages:
sophie: Hey folks — quick check. My baby has her first pediatric appointment during week 1 of my return-from-leave (Thu AM). I planned a partial return that week (3 mornings onsite, afternoons remote) but need to shift Thu to fully remote. Do I need to file an amendment to my phased return? Also wondering about coverage for the customer demo scheduled that afternoon — can we swap?

eva (People Ops): You can absolutely switch that day to fully remote, no formal amendment required for a one-off change. Just update your phased-return Google Calendar block and ping your manager. If you expect multiple swaps (>2 days) then we ask for a quick note in the HR portal so we can track workload impact for payroll/benefits.

jordan (manager): @sophie yup fine with me. I'll cover the demo if you want — I can join as backup and handle Q&A. Do you want me to take the customer-facing slides or should we rehearse a 10m handoff?

sophie: Thanks @jordan! If you could handle Q&A that would be huge. I can share a 5-bullet cheat sheet by EOD. No rehearsal needed.

lina (Payroll): Re: paperwork — no change to pay if it's a one-day remote shift. If you added any unpaid days on the original schedule we need to update the time-off entry. Also reminder: if you exceed 40 hours on-call during your phased return week and want call-pay adjustments, submit the call-pay form.

sophie: Good to know. I had originally marked Thu as "partial PTO morning" in the portal but hadn't finalized. I'll flip it to "work remote" now. Where's the PTO toggle?

ev a (People Ops): Portal link in case useful: https://redwood.hr/leave/phased-return -> click "edit" on your active plan. The toggle is under "day-level adjustments". If you run into the old portal bug where edits show pending, ping me and I'll approve server-side.

hr-bot: Your Leave Amendment Draft has been created: https://redwood.hr/drafts/AMND-2350108642. To submit: open the draft and click Submit. (This is an automated notice.)

sophie: Got the draft link, thanks. I submitted the change (switched from partial PTO -> remote). @lina can you confirm payroll sees the update?

lina (Payroll): Confirmed — I can see the edit in the admin console. No pay impact. Filing a follow-up note to the demo calendar that Jordan is cover.

sophie: Appreciate it. One more Q — my partner has a double shift next Tue so I might need to extend one morning of remote to cover daycare pickup next week. If that becomes 2 mornings remote, is that still fine without amendment?

ev a (People Ops): Two single-day tweaks in a rolling 14-day window are fine, no formal amendment. If it becomes a pattern (3+ days/week or more than 3 edits in a month) we'll ask for a short amendment so teams have visibility. We'll also offer temporary backfill conversations if coverage risk grows.

jordan (manager): If you want, create a quick shared checklist in the demo doc with owners for next week — helps if more swaps happen.

sophie: Will do. Thanks all :heart:
